title: One
description: A tab made by one pages.add call.

add.text: Tab **One**: made by `instant.pages.add({name: "one", title: "One"})`, then this text by `one.content.add({type: "part-text", text})`.

yml0qof6.text: Tab **One**: made by `instant.pages.add({name: "one", title: "One"})` and marked a tab by `instant.tab({name: "one", tab: true})`. This text is `one.content.add({type: "part-text", text})`.
